text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000088 bills 99215 far above risk-adjusted expectation, mostly on patients with few or no chronic conditions, but the records returned are too few to confirm or rule out upcoding.","leaning":"pattern_consistent_with_upcoding","interpretation":"The claims pattern points toward upcoding rather than a sicker panel. The 99215 share is elevated in every complexity band, not just among complex patients, and most 99215s fall on patients with 0 or 1 conditions. Sampled low-complexity examples include claims for follow-up (Z09), UTI (N39.0) or abdominal pain (R10.9) alone, such as C0037661, C0037749 and C0037815. The documentation evidence is thin and mixed. Only 5 documented 99215s came back: one was documented below the billed level (C0037602, moderate MDM), while four supported high MDM, including low-complexity claim C0037818. Three notes claim moderate-plus data review with no lab or test line on the claim, which is weak evidence of templated or inflated notes. A reviewer should first request a larger chart sample focused on the low-complexity 99215s listed in the packet, and check whether the notes contain real independent complexity or cloned text."}
